# ApexTrader - Next-Gen High-Frequency Trading Terminal & AI Entry Scanner

ApexTrader is an institutional-grade high-frequency financial trading platform engineered for trading Synthetic Volatility Indices (Vol 10 1s, Vol 25 1s, Vol 50 1s, Vol 75 1s, Vol 100 1s), Forex pairs, and Cryptocurrency contracts with microsecond tick execution.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Safaricom M-Pesa STK Push Integration**: Automated instant mobile money deposit processing via Safaricom Daraja & GravityPay API.
- **Cryptocurrency Support**: Multi-chain crypto deposits and withdrawals for Tether USD (USDT TRC20/ERC20), Bitcoin (BTC), and Ethereum (ETH).
- **AI Entry Scanner Engine**: Real-time algorithmic indicator convergence scanning (RSI, MACD, EMA, Volatility Momentum) providing high-confidence trade entry signals.
- **Trade Contract Types**: Even/Odd digit contracts, Match/Differ digit barriers, Over/Under digit barriers, and Rise/Fall options with payouts up to 850%.
- **Automated Risk Management**: Built-in Target Profit & Stop Loss triggers, automated Martingale multipliers, and session performance metrics.

## Supported Markets
- Synthetic Volatility 10 (1s) Index
- Synthetic Volatility 10 Index
- Synthetic Volatility 25 (1s) Index
- Synthetic Volatility 25 Index

- Synthetic Volatility 75 Index

- Synthetic Volatility 100 Index
